fact: The MAPS assessment (March 2025) states e-GP, with e-Soumission, e-Paiement, e-Contrat and e-Management modules, was finalised in 2021 and has been used by all central ministries since 2023 but is not yet fully operational, and that SIGMP data covered only 52.2% of contracts per the 2021 PEFA.
title: Evaluation du système de passation des marchés de Madagascar (MAPS)
